div.div:
Chen notation
Rectangle Entity
Diamond Relationship
Oval Attribute (underlined = PK)
Dashed oval Derived attribute
Thick line Total participation
Thin line Partial participation
FKs are not drawn as attributes — the relationship diamonds already encode them.
USER (right) = same entity as USER (top-left), duplicated to reduce line crossings.
